name: AI sessions on axHub (ai-modes@1)
description: AI for any AXF app, always live on axHub: sessions run on the hub side (the assistant behind axHub's sign-in wall) and never end because the app closed — only an explicit close ends one. HubAiSessionClient implements the kernel's AiSessionClient (start/attach/send/stream/stop/close/list), follows sessions across dropped connections (resumes from the last seq, replay/gap/reset), streams replies as a Flow, and replaces the axf.ai.session placeholder. AiService: the kernel's mode registry, mode resolution with per-trigger overrides (triggers@1 args.mode), UAC gating (the hub account's answer from GET /me when known, else the runtime role + principal; non-admins get plain chat), model choice and per-device resume cursors. Settings group: mode, model, read replies aloud (a flag; speaking is speech@1 / lib-speech).
